t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pay attention to the pairs of gnomes and their colours. Also pay attention to the forest you enter as one is lighter than the other and pay attention to the basket and how many mushrooms are collected to make the best choices to gain the most points.

vb_textbox.text: Hi, Firstly you do not have to pay attention to the look or size of the gnome the main focus is to recognise which colour gnome goes to which forest to gain the maximum amount of mushrooms.Each of the pair of gnomes leads to a separate forest, one is lighter than the other so pay attention to this. Each forest contains a different colour basket and a different amount of mushrooms depending on which gnome you choose.The ultimate goal is to work out which coloured gnomes gain the most points via how many mushrooms you collect.good luck
